Because Parameter Store synchronizes settings with GitHub repository, versioning flags next to code.

optionReasons.saa-ini-038:option:0: Cache and backup do not define terms — they are storage states, not the traffic/return distinction.
optionReasons.saa-ini-038:option:1: The type of application (mobile/web) has no relation to the concepts.
optionReasons.saa-ini-038:option:3: Different regions do not define 'transit' — data can traffic within the same AZ.

finalJustifications: Because in transit = data traveling through the network (protected by TLS) and at rest = data recorded on disks/banks/buckets (protected by storage encryption).
Because in transit are the data loaded in memory RAM and at rest the data resident in the registrars CPU during processing.
Because in transit it applies only to public API traffic and at rest only to relational banks SQL Account.
Because data at rest is already protected by physical isolation of the data center — encryption only imports in transit via the internet.

optionReasons.saa-ini-157:option:1: Larger instances absorb more attack — but no BLOQUEIAM abuse; cost rises and the problem remains.
optionReasons.saa-ini-157:option:2: Lock TODA a 443 knocks down the website for legitimate users.
optionReasons.saa-ini-157:option:3: The GuardDuty DETECTA and alert — it does not block traffic automatically on its own.

finalJustifications: Because the rate-based rule of WAF count IP requests in time window and automatically block (per period) those who exceed the limit — contained gross force, normal users intact.
Because the rate-based rule activates a captcha for all visitors to the site, and only verified humans can submit the login form.
Because the rate-based rule moves the login form to the CloudFront, where the attempts of brute force dilute between the edge locations.
Because the rate-based rule limits the entire site to a fixed ceiling of requests per minute, taking down the attack along with the excess traffic.

optionReasons.saa-ini-158:option:3: The GuardDuty detects log threats — is not DDoS mitigation service.

finalJustifications: Because Shield Advanced Copper Layers 3/4 and 7 with advanced mitigation, access to the DDoS Response Team and cost protection against escalating peaks in attacks.
Because Shield Advanced is the only level that protects against SQL injection, the most common volumetric vector in the layer 7.
Because Shield Advanced works without additional cost on Enterprise accounts, activated along with contracted support plan.
Because Shield Advanced moves the application to an armored region of AWS, isolated from the public internet during attacks.
